label: Singapore
short_description: Marina Bay's flagship towers, Orchard Road shopping and Sentosa's resort strip.
intro: Singapore's coverage in this directory spans the full range, from flagship city hotels around Marina Bay and the Civic District to Orchard Road shopping-district properties and resort-style stays on Sentosa Island. As a compact, transit-connected city-state, the choice between neighborhoods usually comes down to proximity to Changi Airport, the Central Business District, or leisure attractions rather than raw distance.
